features.title: receipt-schema + check_receipt + GATE-POST-DEV-RECEIPT
features.description: subagent 回执 JSON 三件套：(1) context/team/engineering-spec/receipt-schema.yaml 定义 schema_version=1.0 + 顶层 required_fields（feature_id / status / commit_sha / files_changed / test_summary / touches_violations / concerns / missing_context / block_reason / timestamp / schema_version）+ status enum=[DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, BLOCKED]（detail-design §3.6 + §6.2 法定字段）；(2) scripts/lib/check_receipt.py 实现 SUPPORTED_VERSIONS 双层校验 + status 枚举 + 必填字段断言（detail-design §6.1 + §6.2）；(3) scripts/gates/plugins/post_dev_receipt.py 扫 tasks/F-xxx.md status=done 对应 receipt.json 必须存在 + status ∈ {DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS}（detail-design §5.1 触发组：phase-transition / submit）；(4) registry.yaml 注册 GATE-POST-DEV-RECEIPT。先写 schema yaml + check_receipt 单测固化字段集，再写 plugin precheck 兼容历史无 receipt 路径自然过滤（V-07 D-006）。
acceptance: TC-F1-1: pytest tests/lib/test_check_receipt.py 全绿（schema_version=1.0 命中 SUPPORTED_VERSIONS / 缺 required → exit 1 / status enum 越界 → exit 1）
TC-F1-2: pytest tests/gates/test_post_dev_receipt.py 绿——tasks/F-001.md status=done + receipt.json 缺失 → fail；receipt.json status=BLOCKED → fail；status=DONE_WITH_CONCERNS → pass
TC-F1-3: V-02 沙盒 e2e（F-008 内）——run.py --trigger=phase-transition 在 features.json done feature 缺 receipt.json 时 exit 1 含 GATE-POST-DEV-RECEIPT FAIL 行（detail-design §5.4）
TC-F1-4: V-07 自然隔离回归——historic completed REQ（如 REQ-2026-007）触发 ci 通道时 GATE-POST-DEV-RECEIPT 不命中（trigger 不含 ci）

features.title: features-schema + check_features + GATE-FEATURES-SCHEMA
features.description: features.json 强制 schema 化：(1) context/team/engineering-spec/features-schema.yaml 定义 top-level schema_version + requirement_id + features[]，每条 feature required={id,title,description,modules,depends_on,depends_on_features,complexity,touches,acceptance}（status 不在 features-schema 内——dispatch_precheck 改读 tasks/F-xxx.md frontmatter status，避免 hash drift），complexity enum=[trivial,light,medium,heavy]（detail-design §3.6 字段表）；(2) scripts/lib/check_features.py 双层 schema_version 校验 + 字段集 + 枚举断言；(3) scripts/gates/plugins/features_schema.py：applies_when.changed_files=['requirements/*/artifacts/features.json'] 自然过滤 historic（detail-design §5.1 + §5.3）；(4) registry.yaml 注册 GATE-FEATURES-SCHEMA（pre-commit / phase-transition / submit / ci 四触发组）。
acceptance: TC-F2-1: pytest tests/lib/test_check_features.py 全绿（status=invalid_value / complexity=giant → exit 1；缺 required → exit 1）
TC-F2-2: pytest tests/gates/test_features_schema.py 绿——changed_files 不含 features.json → Skip；含 features.json + 字段非法 → fail
TC-F2-3: V-05 沙盒（F-008 内）schema gate exit 1 验收（detail-design §5.4）
TC-F2-4: V-07 changed_files 自然过滤回归——historic features.json 不在 commit diff → Skip

features.title: task-frontmatter-schema + check_task_frontmatter + GATE-TASK-FRONTMATTER
features.description: tasks/F-xxx.md frontmatter 强制 schema 化：(1) context/team/engineering-spec/task-frontmatter-schema.yaml 定义 required={feature_id,title,status,complexity,depends_on,touches,created_at,updated_at}，status/complexity 枚举与 features-schema 对齐（detail-design §3.6）；(2) scripts/lib/check_task_frontmatter.py 解析 markdown frontmatter（python-frontmatter 或 yaml.safe_load）+ 字段断言；(3) scripts/gates/plugins/task_frontmatter.py：applies_when.changed_files=['requirements/*/artifacts/tasks/*.md'] 自然过滤；(4) registry.yaml 注册 GATE-TASK-FRONTMATTER（同 features_schema 触发组）。注意：派发模板 feature-task.md.tmpl 必须先于 F-007 落地新增 touches 字段（来源：requirements/REQ-2026-008/notes.md:20），但模板归 F-007，本 feature 仅校验。

TC-F3-2: pytest tests/gates/test_task_frontmatter.py 绿——tasks/*.md 不在 changed_files → Skip；含 tasks/F-001.md 字段非法 → fail

features.title: dispatch_precheck.py + dispatch_state.py 锁工具 + settings.json/guard.sh 接入
features.description: 派发前置 PreToolUse hook 链：(1) scripts/lib/dispatch_state.py 实现 L1 公开 API `flock_state_file(req_dir)` 上下文管理器（fcntl.LOCK_EX）+ StateFileHandle.read/write，及 L2 简单函数 read_state/write_state/clear_state；TOCTOU 修复（D-008，detail-design §3.2 + §3.3）；(2) scripts/lib/dispatch_state_cleanup.py CLI 入口 `--req-dir`，幂等清理（detail-design §3.3 表）；(3) .claude/hooks/dispatch_precheck.py：tool_name 断言 == 'Agent'（D-007）；解析 prompt 首行 `^feature_id:\s*(F-\d{3})\s*$`（D-005 #3 / D-007）；fail-open 7 场景（detail-design §2.4 表）+ BLOCKED 3 场景（B-1 status≠pending / B-2 depends_on 未 done / B-3 已有 current_feature）；调 dispatch_state.flock_state_file 单 with 块原子性（D-008）；(4) .claude/hooks/pre-tool-use-guard.sh 加 Task case 转发到 dispatch_precheck.py（detail-design §3.7）；(5) .claude/settings.json PreToolUse.matcher='Task'（fuzzy 匹配 Agent，D-007）。

features.title: touches_guard.py + plugins/touches_violation.py 双层拦截
features.description: touches 越界双层拦截（D-003）：(1) .claude/hooks/touches_guard.py：Edit/Write/MultiEdit 触发；读 .dispatch-state.json.current_feature；读 tasks/<current>.md frontmatter.touches；判断目标 file_path 是否匹配 touches glob；不匹配则 append 到 receipt.json.touches_violations[]（路径 + ts + tool）；不存在 receipt.json 时建空骨架（feature_id + schema_version + touches_violations[]，outline §3.4）；放行（不 exit 2，软拦截）；(2) .claude/hooks/pre-tool-use-guard.sh 加 Edit/Write case 转发到 touches_guard.py；(3) scripts/gates/plugins/touches_violation.py：phase-transition / submit 触发；扫 features.json 列出的 done feature 对应 receipt.json 任一 touches_violations[].length>0 → fail（硬拦截，outline §3.5）；(4) registry.yaml 注册 GATE-TOUCHES-VIOLATION。
acceptance: TC-F5-1: bats tests/hooks/test_touches_guard.bats 绿——目标在 touches glob 内 → 不写 violations；目标越界 → 写 violations 但放行 exit 0；receipt.json 不存在 → 建空骨架（outline §3.4 + §3.5）
TC-F5-2: pytest tests/gates/test_touches_violation.py 绿——任一 done feature receipt.touches_violations[]>0 → gate fail
TC-F5-3: V-03 沙盒（F-008 内）——派 F-001 改 .claude/hooks/dispatch_precheck.py（不在 F-001 touches 内）→ touches_guard 软拦截写 violations → 后续 phase-transition fail
TC-F5-4: TOCTOU 回归——touches_guard 必须走 dispatch_state L2（read_state 单次）；不能走 read+write 顺序
